name: fleet-lsp
description: Pinned, ready language servers for Claude Code's LSP tool. Add it from the release branch: fredericrous/fleet-lsp#release. Needs Claude Code 2.1.288 or newer and the fleet-lsp binary (brew install fredericrous/tap/fleet-lsp).

plugins.name: fleet-lsp
plugins.description: rust-analyzer, gopls, pyright and typescript-language-server, each verified against the repository's pin and answering only once loaded
